observed_dpsdk.wire_dispatch: comm/dummy_node.cpp copies request.operation directly into ManagementRequest

impact: A wire-v1 EnableHold request is interpreted as CancelMotion by the committed DPSDK core.
BeginMotion is interpreted as Stop and GetOperation is interpreted as Stop.
ROS cannot execute the R06 device action lifecycle or R07 device SIL without violating C05.
ros_behavior: ROS uses the published C05 values and does not add compatibility aliases for the stale DPSDK values.
resolution_required: DPSDK maps published wire operation values to internal operations or adopts the published enum values.
D06 service and D05 lifecycle acceptance are rerun with C05 vectors.
A committed long-lived VirtualCAN SIL peer exposes state/status/command/manage endpoints for J1 and six-axis profiles.
ROS reruns R06 and R07 cross-process cases against that committed artifact.
